title: gnaphalium peruvianum
intro: Gnaphalium peruvianum, commonly known as Peruvian feather grass, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Gnaphalium peruvianum include its ability to reduce pain and swelling, as well as its antiseptic and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
